This test suite addresses the previously identified inadequacies by covering all the requirements, including the previously uncovered requirement RW-SW-21. It includes positive test cases for all the alarms, ensuring they trigger under the specified conditions. It also includes boundary value tests for pressure and time thresholds, and it specifies concrete values for inputs, expected results, and alarm severity and messages. The test suite is grounded in the requirement text, and it is syntactically valid and assertive.
